decisions.rationale: SCDNR feature PL103 / OBJECTID 936 is active, open, and explicitly classified Paddle Launch / Ramp on the Catawba. SCDNR's river page locates the carry-in at the Manchester Creek mouth with nearby parking. The exact ramp toe is not field-surveyed.

severity.catawba-river-rock-hill-sc9: review because its generalized matched flowline is 273 ft away despite the official launch point being 6 ft from mapped water

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if SCDNR replaces or relocates feature PL103, or field imagery identifies a materially different launch point.
